roadmap.title: From Pinterest Photo to Installation — Real 6–8 Week (~2 Month) Roadmap
roadmap.intro: We set transparent engineering expectations. Every custom kitchen and cabinetry commission follows 5 structured stages and completes in approximately 2 months.

1.title: Consultation & 3D Design
1.description: Come with a Pinterest photo, rough idea, or empty room plan. Our designer prepares your project: furniture 3D design costs 30 GEL / m² (measured by front elevation / წინხედით); full interior design is $15–$20 / m² (measured by floor area / იატაკის კვადრატულობით).

2.title: Quote Approval & Engineering Blueprints (ახაზვა)
2.description: Millimeter-exact engineering blueprints, hardware selection, and technical review. Design changes and budget adjustments can be reviewed upon request before manufacturing starts.

3.title: Material Preparation, Cutting & Edge-Banding
3.description: Industrial board cutting and precision edge-banding across our specialist partner facilities. The 5–14 day window depends on company workload and season.

4.title: Specialized Finishing — Painted MDF, CNC Router, Metalwork
4.description: Painted MDF (შესაღები მდფ) adds +7–10 days; 3D CNC routing work (რუტერული სამუშაო) adds +5 days. Custom iron structures are laser-welded and thermostatically powder-coated.

5.title: Assembly, Nationwide Delivery & Installation
5.description: Full assembly, safe transport, and turnkey on-site installation anywhere in Georgia (included in the agreed project quote).

faq.title: Essential Answers Before Starting Your Project
faq.intro: Everything you need to know about design fees, our 2-month production timeline, partner materials, and nationwide installation.
faq.ctaText: Send us a Pinterest photo or room dimensions on WhatsApp, or estimate your project right now with our AI Consultant.

1.q: How much does kitchen or furniture 3D design cost, and how is the area measured?
1.a: Our in-house designer provides two clear options: Furniture 3D design and engineering blueprints cost 30 GEL per m², measured by the front elevation (facade projection) of the cabinetry. Full interior design costs $15–$20 per m², measured by the room’s floor area.

2.q: How long does it take to manufacture and install a custom kitchen?
2.a: From a Pinterest photo to completed installation, the full process takes approximately 2 months (6–8 weeks): 1) 3D Design — ~1 week; 2) Price agreement & engineering blueprints (ახაზვა) — 7–10 days; 3) Material cutting & edge-banding — 5–14 days (depending on supplier workload and season); 4) Assembly & installation — ~1 week (painted MDF adds +7–10 days; 3D CNC routing adds +5 days).

3.q: Can I start a custom kitchen order with just a Pinterest photo?
3.a: Yes. We manage projects end-to-end starting from a Pinterest photo. Share your inspiration image—our team will measure your space, create the 3D design, agree on the budget, produce millimeter-exact blueprints, and install the finished furniture.

4.q: Do you manufacture soft or upholstered furniture (sofas, armchairs, upholstered beds)?
4.a: No, we do not make soft or upholstered furniture. We manufacture all cabinetry and architectural furniture excluding soft furniture: custom kitchens are our #1 priority, alongside built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, wall paneling, commercial spaces, and laser-welded/powder-coated metalwork.

5.q: Which material suppliers and technologies do you use?
5.a: We work alongside Georgia’s leading material and processing partners: LTB (materials & hardware/mechanisms), Imeri (Italian-Spanish boards + cutting & edge-banding), Geo Decor (cutting & processing), Kasta (laminate & Kronospan), Oldlami (Starwood materials & service), and Ionfasha (material imports). We also utilize CNC routing, laser cutting, laser metal welding, and thermostatic powder coating.

6.q: Do you deliver and install outside Tbilisi across Georgia?
6.a: Yes, we operate across all of Georgia—at any location including Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi, and regional projects. Safe transportation and on-site installation are included in the agreed project quote.
